AuthorizedMember.title: AuthorizedMember
AuthorizedMember.description: Authorized team member entry keyed by normalized lowercase email, granting USER or ADMIN role access to shared weighbridge operations.

email.description: Normalized lowercase Google email address matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Optional team member label or operator name.

role.description: Assigned role: ADMIN (add/delete USERs, access/manage records) or USER (scan slips, add records, access all shared records).

addedByEmail.description: Verified email of the Owner or Admin who added this member.

addedByUid.description: Firebase UID of the Owner or Admin who created the member record.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the member was added.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the member role or profile was updated.

TruckWeightRecord.title: TruckWeightRecord
TruckWeightRecord.description: A verified weighbridge document record comparing current truck weight against the latest prior weight for the same vehicle across all team records.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the user, admin, or owner who saved the record.

createdByEmail.description: Optional verified email address of the user/admin who logged the record.

createdByRole.description: Optional role label of the member who logged the record.

vehicleNumber.description: Display vehicle/truck registration number extracted from the weighbridge slip (e.g. BUG T-11-1633).

vehicleKey.description: Normalized uppercase alphanumeric key for strict same-vehicle comparison.

truckWeight.description: Verified empty/tare/final truck weight in kilograms.

weightDate.description: Weighing date string extracted or confirmed from the weighbridge document.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

previousWeight.description: Latest prior valid truck weight in kilograms for the same vehicle, omitted if first record.

weightDifference.description: Absolute difference in kilograms between truckWeight and previousWeight (0 when no previous record).

alertStatus.description: Alert severity computed from weightDifference against configured thresholds.

telegramMessageId.description: Telegram message ID returned by the secure backend relay function.

documentImageTelegramFileId.description: Telegram file_id of the original weighbridge slip photo sent to the bot.

sourceLabel.description: Source field label identified on the document (e.g. Tare Weight, First Weight, Second Weight).

notes.description: Optional operator or OCR context notes.

RuntimeSettings.title: RuntimeSettings
RuntimeSettings.description: Verification thresholds and OCR/relay runtime settings readable by authorized team members and writable only by the owner.

neutralMaxKg.description: Maximum absolute KG difference for NEUTRAL status (default 4).

greenMaxKg.description: Maximum absolute KG difference for GREEN_SIGNAL status (default 15).

orangeMaxKg.description: Maximum absolute KG difference for ORANGE_WARNING status (default 19); above is RED_ALERT.

minOcrConfidence.description: Minimum OCR confidence (0.0-1.0) below which manual confirmation is forced.

autoSendTelegram.description: Whether confirmed records automatically trigger the backend Telegram relay.

telegramRelayUrl.description: HTTPS URL of the deployed Firebase Cloud Function relay endpoint.

appCheckDebugToken.description: Owner-managed Firebase App Check debug token UUID synced across team devices.

OwnerAdminConfig.title: OwnerAdminConfig
OwnerAdminConfig.description: Owner-only administrative configuration metadata (never contains raw Telegram Bot Token).

telegramChatIdLabel.description: Configured Telegram Chat ID reference (or masked identifier) for owner visibility.

firebaseConfigNote.description: Owner-managed Firebase integration notes or environment identifier.

ocrStrictFinalWeight.description: Prefer second weighing when multiple empty check weighings appear.

AdsBannerConfig.title: AdsBannerConfig
AdsBannerConfig.description: Owner-only managed Ads configuration (hidden from Admins and Users in settings UI) controlling optional in-app banner display.

adCodeSnippet.description: Owner-entered Ads code, AdMob Ad Unit ID, or HTTPS ad tag.

SlipFormatTemplate.title: SlipFormatTemplate
SlipFormatTemplate.description: Custom weighbridge slip format marked and uploaded by Owner so Gemini OCR extracts vehicle number, weight, and date accurately for all users.

AppUpdateRelease.title: AppUpdateRelease
AppUpdateRelease.description: App update release metadata published exclusively by Owner or Admins so all authorized users receive an in-app download pop-up notification.

versionCode.description: Monotonically increasing Android build version code greater than the installed app version.

fileName.description: Original APK file name ending with .apk.

fileSizeBytes.description: Exact byte size of the uploaded APK package.

sha256Checksum.description: 64-character lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the APK file.

downloadUrl.description: HTTPS download URL pointing to the new APK release.

releaseNotes.description: Admin message shown inside every user's pop-up update notification.

isMandatory.description: Whether the pop-up notification requires downloading before dismissal.

publishedByEmail.description: Verified lowercase email of the Owner or Admin who uploaded the update.

publishedByRole.description: Role of the publisher (OWNER or ADMIN).

publishedByUid.description: Firebase UID of the Owner or Admin who published the release.

/authorized_users/{memberEmail}.description: Managed multi-user access directory keyed by lowercase email. Owner creates/promotes/deletes ADMINs and USERs; ADMINs add/delete USERs.

/truck_weight_records/{recordId}.description: Shared weighbridge verification records readable by all authorized USERs, ADMINs, and the OWNER.

/app_settings/runtime_config.description: Singleton runtime thresholds, relay configuration, and synced App Check token readable by authorized members and writable only by the owner.

/app_settings/ads_config.description: Owner-managed Ads banner configuration readable by authorized members for display and writable only by Owner.

/app_settings/app_update.description: Active app update release metadata readable by all authorized members and writable/deletable only by Owner or Admins.

/slip_templates/{templateId}.description: Custom Owner-marked weighbridge slip templates readable by all authorized members for OCR extraction and writable only by Owner.
